title: McCabe Scholars
text: Swarthmore's McCabe Scholarship is awarded to one or more men or women from the Delmarva Peninsula and from Southeastern Pennsylvania (Chester, Montgomery, and Delaware counties). There is no separate application or selection process. Rather, all students who apply (both early and regular are considered). The scholarship will cover a minimum of the school's tuition for four years. More information is available at swarthmore.edu.
